name: dacapo
description: Da capo: an orchestrated implementation loop that runs the piece again until it is right. Parallel worker subagents in git worktrees that land their work through GitHub pull requests, an end-user QA subagent with a scored rubric, at the highest level an engineering reviewer of the run's change, a final pull request into main, and a live timeline pane. Three levels: build, review, consolidate. The loop itself is specified by a host-agnostic loop skill (roles, boundaries, host guarantees, report contracts) that other orchestrators can follow.
